newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Mosenergo gets rating comparable to state's.
newsitem.headline: Russia Mosenergo gets rating comparable to state's.

text.p: Standard & Poor's has given Russian regional power utility AO Mosenergo a credit rating ahead of its Eurobond comparable to the ratings of the Russian Federation and international telephone operator Rostelekom, a Mosenergo official said on Wednesday.
But Securities Department Head Natalya Khokholkova declined to say exactly which rating S&P had allocated.
S&P has rated both Russia and Rostelekom BB-.
"The preparatory work for the Eurobond issue is in full swing," Khokholkova told Reuters. "It is not expedient for us to turn to a second rating agency so far, it will be sensible a little later."
Mosenergo plans to issue $150 million in Eurobonds at the end of the second or start of the third quarter of 1997. Salomon Brothers is leading the issue.
Mosenergo also plans to issue level-one American Depositary Receipts, but officials say the Eurobond project was top priority now.
On the Russian Trading System Mosenergo slipped to $1.262 from $1.267 at Tuesday's close.
